originals.citation: Jainta, S., & Jaschinski, W. (2012). Individual differences in binocular coordination are uncovered by directly comparing monocular and binocular reading conditions. Investigative Ophthalmology & Visual Science, 53(9), 5762-5769.

quote: Nevertheless, the impact of horizontal heterophoria on binocular advantages in reading was reported for 13 participants and small heterophorias (range: 0 to 3 degrees exophoria) only (Jainta & Jaschinski, 2012). ... Thus, the first and obvious aim of this present study was to initiate a large-scale replication
notes: Self-replication. Jainta et al. 2014 (@jainta2014) is cited as further evidence of binocular advantages but the N=13 heterophoria study is Jainta & Jaschinski 2012.
